opennyai_summary.final__facts:
This petition has been filed for quashing of FIR No.344/2019 under sections 498A/406/34 IPC registered at PS Mansarovar Park on the ground that the disputing parties have settled their disputes vide settlement deed 4th November, 2019 which is on record of this Court.
4. Marriage of petitioner No. 1 and respondent No. 2 was solemnized on 23rd November, 2016 and one male child was born out of wedlock.
opennyai_summary.decision:
3. Respondent no.2 confirms that all aspects of the settlement have been duly complied with and there is no further amount to be received by her from petitioner no.1.
Pursuant to the differences between themselves they have now obtained decree of divorce by mutual consent dated 5th January, 2022.
Accordingly, the petition is allowed.
Consequently, the FIR No.344/2019 under sections 498A/406/34 IPC registered at PS Mansarovar Park and proceedings emanating therefrom are quashed.
It is however made clear that the said settlement will not affect the rights of the minor child in future.
Parties shall abide by the terms of settlement.
7. Accordingly, the petition is disposed of.
Pending applications (if any) are disposed of as infructuous.
8. Order be uploaded on the website of this court.
opennyai_summary.ANALYSIS: 5. Considering the above settlement between the parties and the chances of conviction of the petitioners being remote and bleak, there is no use continuing with proceedings of the present FIR as it would be a misuse of the process of the Court and an unnecessary burden on the State exchequer.
